purpose: A non-normative receipt of exact successor metadata read from immutable authority commits; the authority repositories remain the sources of truth.

verification.retrieval: GitHub Git Data API tree and blob endpoints at exact commits; local Studio git objects at the exact commit
verification.digestMethod: Git blob SHA-1 over exact bytes plus SHA-256 over exact file and parsed principle-block bytes

refresh.requiredWhen: Any authority commit, successor path, stable ID, Status, Legacy inputs field, or source bytes change.
refresh.procedure: Resolve new immutable authority commits, fetch their Git trees and blobs, semantically review Legacy inputs, regenerate this receipt from those bytes, run offline validation, then run the live verifier with authenticated read access.
refresh.offlineLimit: Offline CI proves ledger and receipt structure, receipt integrity, local bytes, selected reciprocal mappings, and Draft deletion gates. It cannot prove that a private remote still serves the recorded bytes; the authenticated live verifier does that.
